description: Approved five-review remediation. Reuse Bridge.provider_config/2, existing runtime lifecycle, channel_ingress_status and NodeRouter confidential events. Add typed optional infrastructure/runtime adapter contracts with explicit trusted init opts; API resolves bridge, bridge dynamically resolves registered adapter. WebBridge owns shared protocol constructors and config-bound ingress sink; upstream owns package policy/readiness/installation. Remove concrete ZAQ WidgetAdapter and widget env/global configuration. Lifecycle/construction/projection are local-only transport interfaces, not business Actions/tool exposure. Verify with two independent adapters, unsupported capability, confidentiality/provider scoping, opaque boot options and isolation tests. Existing uncommitted branch work is intended input; no application commit/push or final UX approval authorized.
title: [zaq-yx7.7] Replace widget host implementation with dynamic bridge adapter contracts
